t: This is the Ambassadors Theatre on West Street, next to St Martin's Theatre and opposite The Ivy. It opened in 1913 and is one of the smallest theatres in the West End, seating just over four hundred people. It was designed by W. G. R. Sprague, who trained under Frank Matcham and went on to design at least thirty-five theatres. Sir Stephen Waley-Cohen, who manages St Martin's Theatre and produces The Mousetrap, is named as an owner of this one.
